tools.name: query_headcount
tools.description: Headcount summary from the CTO ops database. `filter_by` groups counts: 'team' | 'status' | 'vendor'. Omit to get a flat list of active people (capped at 500).

tools.name: query_budget
tools.description: 2026 R&D budget breakdown from the CTO ops database. Optional `team` filters by team; optional `category` filters by organization.

tools.name: query_risks
tools.description: Risk register proxy: low-confidence classifications from the CTO ops database, bucketed into high/medium/low by confidence. Filter with `severity`.

tools.name: query_work_classification
tools.description: Work-type breakdown for the most recent month in the CTO ops database. Optional `pod` filters by team.
